🔻 Iran’s cultural, civilizational heritage strengthened national unity during war: Baqaei

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei says Iran’s civilizational, cultural and religious heritage played a key role in strengthening national unity and resilience during the 40-day war with the United States and the Israeli regime.

Speaking at the International Omid Media Cup event on Monday, Baqaei said Iran has faced an unprecedented military assault.
​
The official added that national solidarity and the country’s cultural and civilizational heritage have enabled Iranians to defend their homeland despite the technological gap, adding that the experience has created a legacy that should be passed on to future generations.
​
Baqaei also highlighted the role of the Persian language and literature as carriers of Iran’s heritage of wisdom and strength, saying that the combination of Iranian cultural identity and Shiite beliefs has helped people stand firm in defense of their homeland and national dignity.
​
The spokesperson further called on the Basij, a people-centered volunteer organization, to take the lead in promoting national unity and bringing people together under the Iranian flag, stressing the importance of preserving the country’s sovereignty and territorial integrity.

Mohammad Abu Hammoud, 15, from Al-Jib village northwest of occupied Jerusalem, has lost 26 kilograms since his arrest on November 9, 2025, the Commission of Detainees and Ex-Detainees Affairs said. Held in Ofer prison, he suffers severe weight loss while kept in a room where skin and fungal diseases spread among prisoners, amid a shortage of hygiene supplies and damp that compound the risks to his health.
